name: Potatoes Excaloped
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain.
Grease small pans or ramekins with butter, and divide the mashed potatoes between them. Smooth the tops.
Make a cross in the top of the potatoes, and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Use a brush to sprinkle with a few drops of melted butter.
Bake in the oven until browned on top. Carefully remove the potatoes from the molds, and bake to brown the other side.
